run_bm_rasterize_meshes: run the bm_rasterize_meshes benchmark for PyTorch3D mesh rasterization across Python, CPU, and CUDA backends
run_bm_rasterize_meshes_python: run the Python backend rasterization benchmark with icosahedron level 0 and small image size
run_bm_rasterize_meshes_cpu: run the CPU rasterization benchmark with multiple image sizes and faces per pixel configurations
run_bm_rasterize_meshes_cuda: run the CUDA rasterization benchmark with large meshes up to icosahedron level 6
run_bm_rasterize_meshes_cuda_clipping: run the CUDA rasterization benchmark with image plane clipping at varying mesh distances
